from pathlib import Path

path = Path('src/data/lyrics/mashk.md')
before = path.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
header, body = before.split('\\n---\\n', 1)
metadata, roman = header.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
corrections = {
    'Al atash al atash al atash': 'Al-atash al-atash al-atash',
    'Koshish to bahot ki maiṅ ne': 'Koshish to bahut ki main ne',
    'Bhari thi ye mashk bhi maiṅ ne': 'Bhaari thi ye mashk bhi main ne',
    'Aaqa Husain sharminda hoo': 'Aaqa Husain sharminda huṅ',
    'Maula Husain sharminda hoo': 'Maula Husain sharminda huṅ',
    'Aankhoṅ se nazar nahi aata': 'Aankhoṅ se nazar nahiṅ aata',
    'Na baazu hai tan par maula': 'Na baazu hai tan par Maula',
    'Karna tha jo na kar paaya': 'Karna tha jo na paaya',
    'Le jao ye mashk e sakina': 'Le jao ye mashk-e-Sakina',
    'Daatoṅ se bhi mashk ko thaama': 'Daantoṅ se bhi mashk ko thaama',
    'Sine se us ko chupaya': 'Sine se us ko chhupaaya',
    'Par kuch bhi na mai kar paaya': 'Par kuch bhi na main kar paaya',
}
lines = [line.removeprefix('  ') for line in roman.splitlines()]
assert corrections.keys() <= set(lines)
assert lines[0] == '1'
source = body.strip().splitlines()
assert source[0] == '۱' and len(lines) == len(source) == 40
updated = '\\n'.join('  ' + corrections.get(line, line) for line in lines)
path.write_bytes((metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + updated + '\\n---\\n' + body).encode('utf-8'))
